title: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral - English Studies - Consonant Clusters
exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which word correctly contains the `str-` consonant cluster?
questions.explain: The word 'struggle' begins with the `str-` cluster. 'Scream' uses `scr-`, 'spring' uses `spr-`, and 'splendid' uses `spl-`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that features the `spr-` consonant cluster at the beginning.
questions.explain: The word 'spray' starts with the `spr-` cluster (`/spr/`). 'Stray' has `str-`, and 'play' has `pl-`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.explain: The word 'scream' starts with the three-consonant cluster `scr-` (`/skr/`).
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following contains the consonant cluster `bl-`?
questions.explain: The word 'black' features the initial consonant cluster `bl-` (`/bl/`).
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which word contains the initial consonant cluster `gr-`?
questions.explain: The word 'great' starts with the `gr-` cluster (`/gr/`). 'Glare' begins with `gl-`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that features the `tr-` consonant cluster.
questions.explain: The word 'train' contains the initial `tr-` cluster. 'Chain' uses a single affricate `/tʃ/`, 'stain' uses `st-`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which word starts with the consonant cluster `pl-`?
questions.explain: The word 'play' begins with the `pl-` consonant cluster.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Select the word that correctly contains the consonant cluster `bl-`.
questions.explain: The word 'blank' begins with the cluster `bl-`. 'Brake' uses the `br-` cluster.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following sentences contains a word with the `scr-` cluster?
options: The cat will scratch the furniture.
We will scroll through the pages.
questions.explain: The words 'scratch', 'scroll', and 'scream' all begin with the `scr-` consonant cluster (`/skr/`).
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies
